author: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
html: By the way, finding the right page explaining how to make citations took me longer time than expected. I eventually ended at [Wikipedia Citation templates](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Template_messages/Sources_of_articles/Generic_citations) where I found a usable explanation.

author: Matthew Oliphant
html: And who was the last person to comment on Frank's article? Small world. :)

author: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
html: Matthew: I guess you always want the last say :)

author: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
html:
Amazing how fast it goes, but a wikipedia user called [Fred Bradstadt](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/User:Fred_Bradstadt) has already edited my added citations in wikipedia to follow a format that looks much smarter.

New link syntax:\
`<ref name="Nielsen 2002">{{cite web`\
`| last = Nielsen`\
`| first = Jakob`\
`| authorlink = Jakob Nielsen`\
`| title = Interview – Jakob Nielsen, Ph.D.`\
`| publisher = Sitepoint`\
`| date = 2002-11-06`\
`| url = http://...`\
`| accessdate = 2006-11-24}}</ref>`

And in the bottom section added a `references` tag that holds all:

`==References==`\
`<references/>`
